summary_1line: Ravana deceives Sita with an illusory head of Rama, causing her to lament in despair until the illusion vanishes after he leaves.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita collapses in the Ashoka grove before the severed illusory head of Rama and his golden bow lying on the ground.
Sita kneels beside the head of Rama, weeping and reaching toward it while the rakshasas watch from the shadows.
The illusory head and bow of Rama suddenly vanish from the ground as Ravana departs the Ashoka grove.
